rp-pairing.toml:
# One-time pairing secret; moved to /etc/rp and shredded on first boot.
secret = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
user-data:
#cloud-config
# Generated by RP Security (rp provisioning v1)
hostname: "rp-security"
manage_etc_hosts: true

ssh_pwauth: false

runcmd:
- [install, -d, -m, "0755", /etc/rp]
- [install, -m, "0600", /boot/firmware/rp-pairing.toml, /etc/rp/pairing.toml]
- [shred, -u, /boot/firmware/rp-pairing.toml]
- [sh, -c, "set -e; exec >>/var/log/rp-firstboot.log 2>&1; curl -fsSL --proto =https --retry 20 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 -o /root/rp-install.sh https://github.com/Jest-Test-Team/rp_app/releases/download/v0.2.0/install.sh; echo 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa  /root/rp-install.sh' | sha256sum -c -; bash /root/rp-install.sh --release v0.2.0 --repo Jest-Test-Team/rp_app; rpctl setup --no-pairing; echo rp-firstboot: done"]
